youtube_description:
Jesus... four aunties asked when it's my turn. I smiled at the wedding and cried in the car. 💍

Four aunties asked when it's her turn. She smiled for every photo and cried on the drive home.

She: Jesus... four aunties asked when it's my turn. I smiled at the wedding and cried in the car. 💍

Jesus: I was in that car. I heard every word you didn't say.

She: Did I miss some deadline everyone else got?

Jesus: There's no deadline with your name on it.

She: Then why do I feel so behind?

Jesus: Their calendar is not your calling. You owe no one an update.

Jesus: Your story isn't late. It's being written with care.

“Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.”
Psalm 37:4 (BSB)
